items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: And, uh, we started using, uh, Parnell. We were lucky to get him... And I used to like to hire him. And sometimes I'd use, uh, Son Johnson, that's George Johnson, and Parnell together.

ctx.x: It was Saturday night parties. They had night parties.

They had night parties. Especially during the rush week. We used to be busy every night. And, uh, we had the same group with Albert French, Howard Davis, Alvin Alcon, and, uh, Sidney Montaguey on the drums. And very similar, we used a bass, but that was usually a five-piece band. We had a little, a good five-piece band. We could play any kind of music that people wanted. If they wanted Dixieland, we could play that. And, uh, if they wanted any kind of music, we could play it. Now, Al- Howard Davis left town, and…
He's a piano player. No, not here. He's a brother.
